plain.icc: ICC (0 to 1): 0.8 or more = scores repeat closely; 0.5 to 0.8 = moderate; below 0.5 = mostly noise.
plain.spearman: Spearman (-1 to 1): do the answers keep the same order from one run to the next? 1 = same order.
plain.flip: Verdict flip rate: how often the same judge gave pass once and fail the other time (0% = never).
plain.kappa: Cohen's kappa on pass/fail: 1 = always the same verdict; 0 = no better than chance; 0.6 or more is usually read as substantial agreement.
plain.alpha: Krippendorff's alpha (ordinal): agreement among the judges beyond chance; 1 = perfect, 0 = chance, 0.8 or more is reliable, 0.67 to 0.8 tentative, below 0.67 the judges disagree too much to trust one alone.
plain.exact: Exact agreement: share of judge pairs that gave the same score on the same answer.
plain.within_one: Within one: share of judge pairs whose scores differ by at most one point.
plain.ci: 95% confidence interval: the range the mean would likely fall in with a fresh set of similar questions.
